summary: Transform your leadership skills with our generative AI training. Learn to leverage AI for strategic advantage and boost your business performance today.
lede: Generative AI training for business leaders covers applying AI to operational workflows while managing adoption risks. For senior professionals guiding technology adoption, it develops practical approaches to prioritizing use cases and estimating ROI, comparing AI vendors and models, and setting data privacy and governance safeguards. Participants also explore RAG architecture and create prompt guidelines and an AI adoption roadmap.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically structured for decision-makers and senior professionals responsible for guiding technology adoption, managing operational risk, and driving business innovation.
outcomes: AI Total Cost Of Ownership Analysis
modules: AI Use Case Identification and ROI Measurement
Enterprise AI Architecture and Data Strategy
Prompt Engineering Strategy and Workforce Enablement
AI Strategy Integration and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise strategy, digital transformation goals, and basic corporate IT infrastructure. Experience managing departmental budgets, cross-functional teams, or technology procurement processes. No prior coding, programming, or technical machine learning engineering experience is required. Participants should bring a specific operational challenge or potential AI use case from their department to workshop during the practical sessions.
